title: SharePoint to publications
description: Each subfolder of one SharePoint library folder becomes a draft publication with the folder's files attached, read over Microsoft Graph through the credential broker. The mapping never writes a publication date, so nothing goes live until an editor publishes it.

sharepoint-publications-source.name: SharePoint publications (%folderName%)
sharepoint-publications-source.description: Microsoft Graph for the SharePoint library folder whose subfolders become draft publications. The secret stays in the credential broker; this source holds only a reference to it.

sharepoint-folder-to-publication.name: SharePoint folder to publication (%folderName%)
sharepoint-folder-to-publication.description: One dossier folder to one draft publication: the title column, else the folder name; summary and description from their columns when filled; the chosen catalogue; the folder's web address as its source; every file in the folder as an attachment. No publication date: an editor publishes.

mapping.title: {{ listItem.fields.Title|default(name) }}
mapping.attachments: [{% for doc in documents.value|default([]) %}{% if doc.file is defined %}{% if not loop.first %},{% endif %}{"filename": {{ doc.name|json_encode|raw }}, "endpoint": {{ ('/drives/' ~ (doc.parentReference.driveId|default(parentReference.driveId|default(''))) ~ '/items/' ~ doc.id ~ '/content')|json_encode|raw }}}{% endif %}{% endfor %}]

sharepoint-publication-documents.name: Attach SharePoint documents (%folderName%)
sharepoint-publication-documents.description: Fetches every file of a dossier folder through the Graph source and attaches it to the publication object. It runs inside the synchronization, so a cron run keeps the files; nothing is written to anyone's Files folder.

sharepoint-publications-pull.name: SharePoint to publications (%folderName%)
sharepoint-publications-pull.description: Lists the subfolders of one SharePoint library folder and writes each as a draft publication with its files.
